verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card issuing, authorization/spend controls, and corporate cards with spend controls, which supports issuing physical cards to employees with rules, but evidence does not explicitly confirm role-based permissions tied to employee roles or physical card issuance specifics (vs virtual). missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance workflow, role-based employee permission mapping, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the employee card issuance UI.
